parameters.content:
### Vorschau / keine Änderung
Der Workflow ist im `dryRun` oder es gibt nichts zu ändern. Prüfe die Ausgabe von **Persönliche Termine vorbereiten**.

const { changes = [], summary } = $input.first().json; // {{{ Terminal-styled design tokens (shared with the inari health-monitor digest) const palette = { bg: '#eef1f5', card: '#0b0f14', cardBorder: '#1c2530', divider: '#182029', text: '#d6e0ea', muted: '#5b7284', comment: '#4a7a6b', accent: '#5ec8f2', added: '#3ddc84', removed: '#ff5c7a', }; const mono = "ui-monospace,'JetBrains Mono','SFMono-Regular',Menlo,Consolas,'Liberation Mono',monospace"; // }}} const rowsHtml = changes .map((c) => { const isPut = c.method === 'PUT'; const color = isPut ? palette.added : palette.removed; const tag = isPut ? '[ PUT ]' : '[ DEL ]'; return ` ${c.when ?? '--.--. --:--'} ${c.label} ${tag} `; }) .join('\n'); const added = changes.filter((c) => c.method === 'PUT').length; const removed = changes.filter((c) => c.method === 'DELETE').length; const statusLine = [added ? `${added} neu/geändert` : null, removed ? `${removed} entfallen` : null] .filter(Boolean) .join(' · '); const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleString('de-DE', { timeZone: 'Europe/Berlin', dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }); const html = `
 
$ n8n run webuntis-radicale --sync
STUNDENPLAN_SYNC
[ SYNC ] ${statusLine || `${changes.length} Änderungen`}
${timestamp} · Zeitraum ${summary?.range ?? '–'}
# changes
${rowsHtml}
generated by n8n @ inari · ${summary?.managedTotal ?? '?'} Termine verwaltet, ${summary?.ignored ?? 0} ignoriert
`; return [{ json: { subject: `[WebUntis] ${statusLine || `${changes.length} Änderungen`}`, html } }];
